description: Freeze the Forgejo patch surface: enumerate every patched file in a checked-in inventory with a bounded touched-file set, and require each upstream rebase to pass the command/API compatibility gate before merge, failing on any unknown upstream form. [Christopher Alexander, Richard Feynman]

Return effective merge mode and language_set_version on every mergeability and merge result across native JSON, Git command output, and Forgejo API/UI, so no caller can attribute a syntax result to Git or the reverse. [Christopher Alexander, Richard Feynman]

Gate release on the capacity profile only: missing or failing profile evidence blocks release, and no slice may be dropped, narrowed, or substituted to reach a target without an explicit plan revision. [Christopher Alexander, Richard Feynman]

Define one MergeNotice record in ruk-core and reuse it unchanged in native JSON merge_notices, the IPC MergeNotices event, CLI stderr, and the Forgejo API/UI, including coalescing, the 100-entry cap, and the truncation flag. [Claude Shannon, Dieter Rams]

Build the repository settings control as a labeled select with inherit, syntax, and git options, showing the effective value and the syntax-differs warning; hide syntax selection under the stock-Git backend and reject it server-side. [Claude Shannon, Dieter Rams]

Render notebook output-clearing notices with affected cell IDs or stable input positions for ID-less cells, and never label a text-fallback notebook result as syntax-verified. [Claude Shannon, Dieter Rams]

Document and implement mode selection in three consistent places (--merge-mode flag, ruk.mergeMode config, repository setting), failing invalid values with E_INVALID before mutation. [Tony Hoare, David Parnas]

Emit a machine-readable conversion preflight report naming every blocking repository, missing promised object, hook requiring porting, and capacity shortfall, exiting nonzero and refusing cutover when any blocker exists. [Tony Hoare, David Parnas]

Publish a closed error-code registry covering unsupported Git commands, syntax worker health, stale preview tuples, and notebook structure declines, with one exit status per code asserted by tests rather than message text. [Tony Hoare, David Parnas]

Vendor the pinned Vue parser sources under crates/ruk-core/vendor/tree-sitter-vue, build parser.c and scanner.c through cc with C11, and expose the ABI-15 language through the audited LanguageFn bridge, proving a clean load and parse before release. [Tony Hoare, John Carmack]

Implement the MDX host adapter on mdxjs mdast_util_from_mdx, verify returned byte offsets against the original UTF-8 buffer, and prove ESM and brace-expression spans are recognized without executing JavaScript. [Tony Hoare, John Carmack]

Validate every composed candidate before publication: mapped region start/end, language, host role, complete child-byte coverage, and a per-line fence/script closing scan, declining to conflict or safe text instead of trusting host parse success. [Tony Hoare, John Carmack]

Implement the notebook adapter with base-presence ID alignment, new-ID collision conflicts, cautious ID-less anchor matching, and the changed-source output/execution_count clearing post-pass on every non-fast-forward syntax-mode result. [Tony Hoare, John Carmack]

Revalidate the full merge tuple (base/head OIDs, effective mode, explicit strategy and diff/merge options, repository generation, policy digest, language-set version and manifest digest, visibility) before any commit or push in both native and Forgejo paths. [Tony Hoare, John Carmack]

Run syntax merging in two reusable bounded worker processes with a 512 MiB address-space limit, a two-second per-file deadline, a 32-triplet queue, and grammar health marking after two crashes in one coordinator lifetime. [Tony Hoare, John Carmack]
